decisions.reason: Wikipedia source text: park was part of Tyson Valley Powder Plant in WWII; 210 acres acquired by St. Louis County in 1955. Quote differs only in rendered unit conversion.
Wikipedia source text: 'In 1979 an additional 410 acre were acquired.' Quote differs only in the rendered unit conversion; fact and numbers match.
EPA release dated 08/01/2017 states the 185-acre Henry's Knob Site is at Henry Knob Road and State Highway 55, Clover Township, York County SC. Quote check failed on curly apostrophe.
